title: Peek
notes: Peeking the explore sub-agent, which has no pane. Cmd+F opens the peeked terminal's find bar over the peek; Escape in it closes the bar and leaves the peek open. Esc is the terminal's, so closing goes by cmd-w (tab.close closes the peek, not the tab behind it). The right-click menu and Cmd-hover underlines need the pointer, which the harness doesn't drive: the headless tests cover them (crates/app/tests/peek.rs).

steps.name: find a word in the peeked terminal
close the find bar, the peek stays

herdr-app.skip: Escape in the find field is typing, which goes to herdr-frontend only
